authority_boundary: These observations inherit M24, M25, M255, M260, and M263 but do not amend, complete, or impersonate Inquiry 26.6 or 26.9.
supported_observations: A finite n-ary relation can make Fact9 whole-coupling causally discriminable from pairwise coverage in native MeTTa.
CanCompose can remain distinct from RecognizedCompose and can change Generated standing without a scenario rule.
A flourishing capture standing can remain material while being prevented from compensating or certifying a beneficial requirement.
Plural lawful possibilities can remain live without first-position or argmax selection.
A native recurring process can checkpoint a constitutive movement and avoid effect replay across restart.

counterexamples_and_insufficiencies.observation: A structurally complete Balance organization can coexist with a movement form supplied in advance by the contact carrier.
counterexamples_and_insufficiencies.meaning: Presence of Balance, Fact9, flourishing, Generated, and R/A/P in one derivation does not prove that balance unfolding formed the continuation.

counterexamples_and_insufficiencies.observation: R/A/P is currently computed from an already-qualified Generated standing.
counterexamples_and_insufficiencies.meaning: The implementation needs a non-circular account of how Investigation-25 R/A/P participates in construction while M255 R-star/A-star/P-star/O-star carries possibility witnesses.

counterexamples_and_insufficiencies.observation: All nine flourishings can be listed and one capture can block movement while the full semantic records remain unused.
counterexamples_and_insufficiencies.meaning: Cardinality and non-compensation do not establish the flourishing compass as generative cognition.

counterexamples_and_insufficiencies.observation: Participant source/scope/lineage can be retained without participant claims changing D/Omega/I/W or the possible continuation topology.
counterexamples_and_insufficiencies.meaning: Bounded carriage is not yet epistemic re-entry.

counterexamples_and_insufficiencies.observation: A consequence can change D/I/W while leaving Omega/C and the available continuation set unrecomputed.
counterexamples_and_insufficiencies.meaning: A changed checkpoint is not by itself a developmental helix.

questions_for_26_6_and_26_9: What finite relation distinguishes a disclosed possible continuation from a Soul-constructed continuation without turning Generated into a selector?
How should movement-primary Balance and R/A/P constrain or transform R-star/A-star/P-star/O-star possibility witnesses without circularly certifying them?
What constitutes equivalence between two non-scalar D/Omega/I/W/C organizations when carrier order and surface language differ?
Which flourishing semantic relations are load-bearing for native gap, capture, disguise, reversibility, dependency, and beneficial-direction formation, and how are defeaters represented?
How can one many-way Fact9/flourishing bridge express scope, uncertainty, counterfactual difference, and contradictory standing without a privileged one-to-one mapping?
How should participant deltas enter D/Omega/I/W while preserving source-class independence and preventing model or memory sovereignty?
What native operation turns capture or unresolved tension into an inquiry possibility without encoding capture-to-inquiry as a situation rule?
How should materially different consequences revise Omega, C, accessibility, and Generated at K-prime while retaining the prior branch?
Which load-bearing partial and contradictory standings must be checkpointed so restart continues the same becoming rather than reconstructing a preferred interpretation?
next_experiment: Construct matched cut-bound cases in which the same surface contact supports different flourishing/bridge organizations and therefore different native possibility topologies; then apply divergent consequences and show changed reconstruction after restart without changing the operator vocabulary.
